meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: MUST USE when asked to find, read, list, search, inspect, fetch, export, or reconstruct coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, OMO/Senpi/pi, oh-my-pi (omp), gajae-code (gjc), OpenClaw, Factory Droid, Amp, Gemini/Kimi/Qwen CLIs, Codebuff, Roo/Kilo/Cline, Kodu, Cursor CLI, Aider, Aside browser-agent sessions, or unknown local agent logs. Covers transcripts, session IDs, rollout JSONL, state SQLite, Claude projects/pre-compact histories, OpenCode messages/parts, child/subagent linkage, cwd/model/time/token filters, archives, and cost clues. Expands fuzzy recall into parallel query lanes and first probes known stores so absent platforms are skipped cheaply. Triggers: coding agent sessions, Codex/Claude/OpenCode/OMO/Senpi/pi/oh-my-pi/omp/gajae-code/gjc/OpenClaw/Droid/Amp/Kodu/Cursor/Aider/Aside sessions, transcript search, session history, session ID, read transcript, token usage, subagent sessions, what did I do yesterday, did we already do this.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并导出各编码助手的会话记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常用多个 AI 编码助手，却总想不起上次怎么写的。
copy.tagline_en: Search and export past conversations from coding assistants
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often lose track of what you did with AI coding tools.

howto.what: 当你问起过去用AI编程助手做过的事时,它不只凭记忆回答,而是先在本机搜索多个编程代理(Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode等)保存的会话记录,用自带脚本找到相关条目,再读取具体转录作为依据。
howto.when: 当你要求查找、读取或搜索本地保存的编程代理会话(如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode),或问“我昨天干了什么”“这是不是已经做过”这类回忆问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我找出昨天在 Codex 里修登录报错的那个会话。
say.note: 会先在本机检索 Codex 会话,再定位匹配项。

say.text: 我们之前是不是在 Claude Code 里讨论过数据库迁移?
say.note: 会翻查会话记录来核对,而不是仅凭记忆回答。

say.text: 读取刚才找到的会话原文,说明 token 用量。
say.note: 会读取该会话转录并显示用量信息。

howto.what_en: When asked about past coding-agent sessions, Claude searches local logs with a bundled script instead of answering from memory, then reads the matched transcript.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find, read, or search local coding-agent sessions (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode), or ask recall questions like 'what did I do yesterday' or 'did we already do this?'.

say_en.text: Find the Codex session from yesterday where I fixed the login error.
say_en.note: Searches local Codex sessions and returns matches.

say_en.text: Did we already discuss the database migration in Claude Code?
say_en.note: Checks session history instead of answering from memory.

say_en.text: Read the raw transcript of that session and show token usage.
say_en.note: Opens the session file and shows usage details.
